book.name: Efeso
book.title: PAS PAULO MENI EFESO EMARE GAENUA

content: Ozana meni nakai poti dara ninu Kristora te-wana tama ipu wenakai.
Are na Tua emo benai ema wero nowena ami nikare awa-uzinoise sana niniu. Anutu meni nikare dorowetiro ebata me nikare gipenua, ebata amira te noiwo.
Ago inoise tama puro osero baitiro wama-ozaire noiwo. Ota awa-ina-dia inoise saitiro dubara dumire noiwo.
Ago wero Ozana nu bega tamuro nikare poti dara niro begara asi meni zasero dinu dubu daimata wewa, asi awa dawa kapai azu, zewai wero dia ina-wa inoise noiwo.
Nakai dubu nuso daimata gege awa; nakai Ozana daimata gege puro nowenakai; nakai utura wau daimata gege pumanisekai sero dorowetinua;
Tua nasokai daimata gege nowia; tuma diai nasokaira susu daimata gege itia; ge ou gutai nasokai daimata gege itia;

Anutu nasokai daimata gege nowia; nu duba nasokai sero amira mama wero noise, duba nasokai sero dia inoise, duba nasokai sero amira nana ena bua inoise, duba nasokai sero amira nana itai-matai inowia.
Tua meni utura gera bua ema neire-neire potinua.
Kristo nu buara putou awa ara tamai nusora kanowero ge ninai ema sero namorekai potinu te puro nowenakai awa.
Amira ge gayai zo ego itia awa, Nu benai ema puro witi ike damu ninua. Ago wero eramare nena nupe potinua awa.
Ota “Nu witi ike damu ninua,” ge amira susu nogo iti? Susu nuso ego ewa: Nu gita osenua. Awa ose bage zebu duru ninua.
Nu osenua ami ewesemuro utu sero dainiro witinua. Awa uture zebure topetamu witinua awa.
Nu ami buara putou kano inoise ema eni aposolo potinua, eni porofete, eni Oziga Ewanana tugata wai ema zazo ewenselis, eni pasto ata gipai ema.
Awa nikare Tuara dubu awa sia-masia wanakare nikare Tuara dubu amira sou wai bua wawa nakai Kristora te-wana tama ipu ami baziro zewai wanisekai bua ema ago ine potinua awa.

Nakai ago i-susauma tuma diaira susu daimata ata Anutura Mai amira susu daimata awa tamamunonakai awa. Tamuro duba daimata wamunonakai. Ago wero amire ema me wamunonakai. Awa nakai baziro Kristo te wamunonakai.

Nakai ema me wero amire noko oko mai pei-kaka ine nuamunonakai. Erama eni awa kotumai nusokare mai pei-kakara ine awa. Are etetenai ema meni etetenawera ge opi nusokare awa bisi bamu ine wero ema amira duba puro kipete-kapete wawi wa ine gegewa-gagewa susawewera. Etetenai ema ami etetenai susu giti tamuro erama etetenitinowera.
Ata nanekai meni awa tani me gege inoise dubara dumi pupinoise tamare ititire dago bazizinomakai giti kopi nasokai Kristo amira nana susumuro nu ine wanekai.

Nu dubu nuso amira giti kopi nuawi agewa sero susumurota susumuro awawera wuwura nuso meni dara potawi te-wana tama ipu nuso ami kei awinowia. Are agewa sero meni bua namorekai sai awa te wamunonakai, awa te-wana tama ipu nuso dago bazizinoise dubara dumi ina-pa inoise nuamunonakai.
Digara nuai ago ine oko nuanekai.
Na Tuara bera sero baitane. Diga kotumai nusokare nena putira itewia amira ninekare ago ine oko nuawe.
Opi sai meni kotumai nusokare be muro mume wenua, are nukare kotumai nusokare zazai ine tepo. Nukare dau, Tuara ge ninidanago inowera, are nuai Anutu meni potitinowia awa oko puro nowera.
Are nukare me nai tepo noise pasina susu giti wamu duba-duba inoise pasina neire-neire berea tepo inoise nowera awa.
Ninekare meni awa Kristora ge ago ine oko niniwa.
Nikare susu nuso gipai, noko ge me Yesura nana itewia awa gipewa niniwa awa.
Ego niniwa awa: Nikare tani gita wero noisowa amira duba matu nisokare meni pasinara duba-duba inoise nutope waya inowia awa dutuniro dowo.
Ago wero dubare kotumai nisokarere kapeteniwo seka-sakama waise.
Duba seka-sakama wosunawise. Duba seka-sakama awa Anutu meni tamawi benau nuso ago ine saramai me kei awinowia awa.
Are nikare ge opi doro ge me gege ina-sa wewo. Nera kota, nakai Kristora te-wana tama ipu daimata amira agewa.
Tini kapai pupinoise pasina oko wawe. Dumu inoise nuawa waiko oko sokumaise.
Dumu wai nisokare ami so be piai Satan toyanoya.
Bewana wai ema meni bewana doro wana nuso meni bua zewai wero waure nenare tamuro erama bogamasare dumi pumaiseyo.
Ge waya be nisokarera ena oko kei awaise. Ge ewanana meni erama soga inowia awa gege toise noiwo. Ago tuawa ge ewanana nisokare meni erama ge ninamunora nukare awa soremamunoya.
Anutura Ozana amire duba nai oko tamawe. Nune ami Anutu meni nakai be bamura ena saore gaise sero duba nasokaira owe wenua awa.
Wiza atata wai, o be dumu wai, o tini kapai, o sero gunai, o sero ziai, amire otaore kotumai waya puro nuai, awa dowo nisokare nana soe oko itaise.
Nikare dumi ina-pa inoise, zo ina-ama inoise, pasina ina-dua wewo. Anutu meni Kristora bua amira pasina nisokare donua, da ago ine wewo.
